name: WPA Academic Quality & Evidence Standard
institution: World Protocol Academy — Institute for Protocol, Diplomacy, Public Communication & Security Studies
purpose: Internal quality-control, transparency and evidence discipline for WPA research, publications, AI-supported workflows and public institutional claims.
boundary: This is an internal WPA quality standard. It is not an accreditation, external ranking, certification of institutional status or third-party endorsement.
quality_target_note: Academic 10+++ is an internal aspirational shorthand for maximum rigor. It is not presented as an externally awarded score.

dimensions.name: Institutional identity and scope
dimensions.requirement: Public descriptions must distinguish research, authorial, analytical, professional, educational and development functions without implying legal, governmental or accreditation status that is not held.

dimensions.name: Evidence and provenance
dimensions.requirement: Material factual claims must be traceable to identifiable public, licensed, WPA-owned or otherwise authorised sources. Unverified material must remain labelled as candidate, provisional or pending verification.

dimensions.name: Capability status truthfulness
dimensions.requirement: Every material capability must be labelled using a controlled status such as LIVE, LIMITED_PRODUCTION, STAGING, BETA, PROTOTYPE, IMPLEMENTED_MVP, PLANNED or UNAVAILABLE_FOR_AUTOMATED_ACTIVATION.

dimensions.name: Version hygiene
dimensions.requirement: A canonical version must be declared for each active public or operational component. Legacy labels may remain only when explicitly identified as historical or compatibility records.

dimensions.name: Human authority and AI governance
dimensions.requirement: AI output, agent consensus or automation must not create institutional authority. Consequential actions require the applicable Human Gate and auditable authorisation.

dimensions.name: Agent mandate discipline
dimensions.requirement: Executive, tactical-operational and external candidate-agent layers must be distinguished. Agent mandates may not self-expand, infer consent as authority or self-authorise AC3 actions.

dimensions.name: Academic and publication integrity
dimensions.requirement: Research and publication workflows must preserve authorship, source fidelity, citation discipline, editorial review, correction rights and clear separation between candidate material and published or DOI-locked outputs.

dimensions.name: Source and rights compliance
dimensions.requirement: No credential bypass, paywall or DRM bypass, restricted scraping, silent download, or unverified RAG ingestion is permitted. Unknown rights status must fail closed.

dimensions.name: Auditability and correction
dimensions.requirement: Material outputs, public metrics, deployment states and governance decisions should be versioned, reviewable and open to documented correction or rollback.

dimensions.name: Deployment and external-impact honesty
dimensions.requirement: Internal, pilot, limited-production and external customer deployments must never be conflated. External impact is claimed only when supported by verifiable delivery evidence.
